plugins.name: wl2bd
plugins.description: Agent Skills by wl2bd. Currently: naming-things, a process for naming a product, company, library or feature (brief, wide generation, screening, argued shortlist, domain checks at the registry); discreet-design, a ladder that makes an agent remove before it draws, with craft rules for what stays and an MVP mode that does less without looking unfinished.
